description: This file defines the ProtoConverter class, which provides static methods for converting, validating, and handling protocol buffer messages related to telemetry, device claims, attributes, RPC requests, and device provisioning within the Thingsboard platform. It interacts with protobuf message types, performs JSON conversions, and manages external proto references.

classes.name: ProtoConverter
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for converting, validating, and handling protobuf messages and JSON serialization/deserialization related to telemetry, device claims, attributes, RPC requests, and device provisioning in the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: convertToTelemetryProto
methods.description: Converts a byte array payload into a PostTelemetryMsg protobuf object, parsing the payload into a TsKvListProto and building the message.

methods.name: validatePostTelemetryMsg
methods.description: Validates and constructs a PostTelemetryMsg protobuf object from a byte array payload, ensuring the TsKvList is not empty.

methods.name: validatePostAttributeMsg
methods.description: Validates and constructs a PostAttributeMsg protobuf object from an existing message, ensuring the key-value list is not empty.

methods.name: convertToClaimDeviceProto
methods.description: Converts a device ID and optional byte array into a ClaimDevice protobuf message, using default secret key if necessary.

methods.name: convertToGetAttributeRequestMessage
methods.description: Creates a GetAttributeRequestMsg protobuf object from byte array data, request ID, and attribute key strings.

methods.name: convertToServerRpcRequest
methods.description: Converts a byte array into a ToServerRpcRequestMsg protobuf object, extracting method and params.

methods.name: buildClaimDeviceMsg
methods.description: Builds a ClaimDevice message with device ID, secret key, and duration.

methods.name: validateTsKvListProto
methods.description: Validates and constructs a TsKvListProto, setting timestamp if zero and ensuring key-value list is not empty.

methods.name: convertToProvisionRequestMsg
methods.description: Parses a byte array into a ProvisionDeviceRequestMsg protobuf object.

methods.name: validateKeyValueProtos
methods.description: Validates a list of KeyValueProto objects, checking keys and parsing JSON values if necessary.

methods.name: convertToRpcRequest
methods.description: Converts a ToDeviceRpcRequestMsg protobuf object into a byte array representing a dynamic message, using JSON serialization.

methods.name: validateDescriptor
methods.description: Validates that a protobuf Descriptor is not null.

methods.name: dynamicMsgToJson
methods.description: Converts a byte array message into JSON string using a protobuf Descriptor.
